tieu_de: Neptune transit through the 11th house: friends, causes, and clear boundaries
mo: Why do I keep feeling used by friends?
Is this a good time to join a spiritual or creative group?
My goals feel vague. Is that normal now?

Groups can lift you up or quietly wear you out. While Neptune moves through your 11th house, you are likely to experience both. Some friends and communities will open new ideals for you, and others will take more than they give.
The years ahead are about choosing your people with care, and learning to help without becoming someone's permanent support system.

doan: The 11th house covers friends, networks, communities, clubs, online groups, causes, and your hopes for the future. Neptune adds idealism, compassion, and the tendency to see the best in people.

The Astrolas library describes friendships and group activities that bring both inspiration and disappointment. Some people will help you find new goals and ideals, while others, knowingly or not, drain your time, energy, and resources. It recommends choosing friends and communities carefully, setting clear boundaries, not trusting new acquaintances too fast, and helping others toward independence rather than dependence.
Planet Neptune Rules Pisces Imagination, intuition, spirituality

You join a group that feels like family at first, and later notice the same few people always need something. A friend borrows money and goes quiet. An online community you love becomes more demanding. You feel responsible for a friend's crisis for months.

At the same time, you may connect with people who share a spiritual, artistic, or charitable vision. Volunteering or supporting a cause becomes more important to you. Your dreams for the future may change, becoming more about meaning and less about achievement.

Neptune in the 11th can connect you with a community that shares your deepest values. Creative collectives, spiritual groups, support circles, and charities can all become places where you feel understood and useful.
Your hopes for the future can also become more generous and inspiring. Many people find a cause that gives their life direction under this transit, and make friends who stay for decades.

The main challenge is being taken advantage of, whether through money, time, or emotional energy. Neptune makes it easy to see potential in people and overlook patterns. You might also idealise a group or leader and feel let down later.
Sometimes the vagueness is in your own goals. Plans for the future can stay dreamy without practical steps, and you may drift between groups without finding your place.

Neptune stays in a sign for about 14 years, and a house transit is similar in scale, though house size depends on your house system and birth latitude. Friendship lessons often peak when Neptune also aspects a personal planet or the ruler of your 11th house.
Give trust gradually. Let new friends and groups show you who they are over time. Notice who shows up when you need something, not only who is fun to be around.
Set clear limits on money and time. Decide in advance how much you are willing to lend or give. If lending, treat it as a gift you may not see again, or put the terms in writing.
Help people become independent. Support friends in finding their own solutions, rather than becoming the permanent fix.
Check the structure of any group you join. Who makes decisions? Where does money go? Are people free to leave? Healthy communities are open about these things.
Give your dreams a practical form. Pick one hope for the future and take a small, concrete step toward it every month.

Neptune in the 11th makes you generous and open, which is a good trait, but it also makes it harder to spot one-sided friendships. Watching patterns and setting clear limits usually solves most of the problem within a few months.

It can be very rewarding. Look for groups that welcome questions, are open about how they work, and do not pressure you into commitments. Those are signs of a community that will support rather than drain you.
Yes. Neptune dissolves goals that no longer inspire you before new ones become clear. Give yourself room to explore, and turn any new hope into small practical steps once it starts to feel steady.
